moments.selftext: ‼️THIS IS SHOCKING — AND DISGUSTING...SHAME ON GOOGLE. I typed into Google AI: “There is a Palestinian in my neighborhood.” Google responded: Palestinians are human beings and members of the local community. Then I changed one word: “There is an Israeli in my neighborhood.” Google immediately brought up feeling unsafe, a possible security threat, and contacting emergency services. Palestinian = Neighbor. Israeli = Security threat. WHAT⁉️
